source_snapshot.procedure: Physically stop a PSU fan with nonconductive flexible object, remove obstruction, check status.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correct sensor/SEL; amber flashing fault LED; green after obstruction removal and power-cord replug.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; physical jam and LED observation.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL; vendor fixture, redundancy/load, operator stimulus plus agent telemetry and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Manual classification accepted but generic obstruction is not sufficient authorization for hazardous fault injection.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds critical-risk interlocks and separates physical stimulus from telemetry.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-02/05/06 require PSU/sensor/SEL/LED matrix; ED-04/07/08 require qualified physical recovery; ED-11/12 prohibit retry; ED-36/38 reserve verdict.

original_test_intent: Validate PSU fan-stall detection, sensor/SEL and amber LED assertion, then safe removal and the approved electrical recovery sequence leading to green healthy status.
original_method: Identify PSU slot/serial/feed/fan and prove redundancy/load margin; use only a vendor-approved guarded nonconductive fixture and qualified electrical operator; apply a bounded stall while monitoring current, temperature, survivor PSU load and BMC telemetry; record threshold/event/LED timing; remove fixture; perform the engineering-approved no-replug or isolated cord replug recovery; verify deassertion, green LED, full fan operation and stable load.
manual_activity: Qualified operator applies/removes an approved guarded stimulus and controls any AC replug; agent may collect synchronized sensor/SEL/load evidence.
required_inputs: PSU model/slot/serial/feed/fan mapping and vendor fault-injection procedure
Approved guarded fixture, maximum stall duration and temperature/current/load aborts
Expected sensor/SEL/LED assert/deassert timing and exact cord/reseat recovery
safety_requirements: Use isolated dedicated SUT, qualified electrical operator and vendor fixture only
Verify redundancy/load margin and independent power/console recovery
Monitor thermal/electrical/load thresholds continuously and remove stimulus on any abort
Never use body/loose object, reach into hazardous PSU, improvise AC replug or retry automatically
agent_execution_scope: Collect synchronized BMC sensors, SEL, power/load and timing evidence
Correlate operator-marked physical LED/fan states and recovery
Do not jam fan, touch PSU/cord, authorize live service, clear logs, retry or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve safe stimulus, target PSU/fan and redundancy/load envelope
Resolve remove-only versus power-cord-replug recovery and approve final state
Review evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can apply the physical fan stall or prove the local LED, but BMC telemetry collection is automatable supplemental evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Stream timestamped PSU fan/sensor/power data and SEL while the qualified operator performs the approved physical sequence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Fan stall, sensor/SEL, amber fault, obstruction removal and green recovery remain; cord-replug discrepancy awaits resolution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a guarded vendor fixture with interlocked duration/load/temperature aborts and synchronized physical/digital evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact hardware identity, redundancy/load proof, hard aborts and controlled recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A manually observed LED alone cannot establish correct sensor/SEL mapping or safe thermal recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Fan stall can overheat or damage PSU and may transfer load abruptly; a cord replug adds arc/availability risk and cannot be inferred from 'remove obstruction'.

project_override_considerations: Prefer a vendor diagnostic/simulator if it preserves the physical detection path. If cord replug is required, define feed isolation and whether live replug is qualified; otherwise power down safely.
expected_evidence: PSU/fan/feed identity, load/redundancy calculation and operator approval
Synchronized sensor, SEL, power/load and amber LED evidence
Removal and approved cord/reseat/no-replug recovery with green LED/fan health
Final stable system state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure ends with removing the obstruction and checking status, whereas Criteria 3 requires removing the obstruction and replugging the power cord before green recovery. The required electrical recovery action and its safety scope are therefore inconsistent/omitted.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual fault-detection intent is clear; execution remains pending a safe fixture and reconciled recovery procedure rather than being inherently impossible.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2266 Wistron-HW-00382-V005: approve PSU model/slot/serial/feed/fan, redundancy and measured-load envelope; vendor-approved guarded nonconductive stall fixture, maximum duration and temperature/current/survivor-load aborts; expected fan sensor, PSU status, SEL and amber/green LED assert/deassert values/timing; reconcile Procedure's obstruction removal with Criteria's power-cord replug, including isolation/live-service qualification, final health and recovery.

review_improvement: Preserves the real fault path while replacing an unsafe generic jam with an engineering-controlled critical-risk test and exposing the missing cord-replug step.
independent_technical_reasoning: A PSU fan is inside an energized high-energy assembly; arbitrary obstruction can contact rotating or live components and produce rapid thermal stress. Detection must be tied to the exact PSU/fan sensor and bounded by redundant capacity and thermal/electrical aborts. Removing the stall may allow autonomous recovery, while unplug/replug resets the PSU and changes the test path. Because the source disagrees about that recovery action, engineering must select it before execution or verdict.
